reuse.why: Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount, and all providers share the new guards, but replacement duplicates the existing unlink field reset.

duplication.why: The change repeats guard orchestration across six handlers, copies unlink cleanup, and adds a transaction downloader substantially matching existing providers.

placement.why: Provider adapters, configuration, and types follow existing layers, but a helper named ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked now performs destructive link replacement.

scope.why: The edits stay focused on the requested linking policies and server-side Fintegra integration.

maintainability.why: Shared linking remains intact, but duplicated cleanup and mutation hidden inside a validation helper make future policy changes harder to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: link.ts implements unlinkAccount's local field reset directly; the local cleanup should be extracted for both replacement and ordinary unlinking while keeping provider disconnection separate.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes the existing downloadEnableBankingTransactions request, error handling, and response normalization into a shorter provider-specific copy.

abstraction_drift.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and a replacement branch that mutates another account, expanding a validation abstraction into unlink orchestration; all six linking handlers still call it.
